Name: Search and Seek: Toddler Style
Overview:
"I wanna play," says your toddler as you're trying to play your Xbox game. So you give him a broken controller to trick him. "Mine doesn't work," cries the kid. "Ok, I will try to find a game for you."

For only $1, Search and Seek-Toddler Style is that game. Your kid can have fun searching for items in 4 different levels, which also includes 5 different musical choices to entertain them.
